FspSnapshot.description: The projected distribution at one save time and its separately reported error terms.

discarded_weight_estimate.description: Probability mass dropped by truncating the uniformization series so far.

mass_defect.description: 1 − (retained probability + sink probability): the mass missing from the vector.

physical_leakage_estimate.description: Probability in the sink: mass that left the bounds box by this time.

probabilities.description: Index order matches states, excludes the absorbing escaping-mass sink.

projected_first_moment.description: Unnormalized moments of the retained law, never of the full unbounded process.

projected_second_raw_moment.description: Σ p(x)·x² per species over the retained states, unnormalized like the first moment.

roundoff_mass_residual.description: Mass-balance residual only; not a rigorous floating-point error bound. It is |mass_defect − discarded_weight_estimate|.

series_tail_upper_bound.description: Cumulative discarded positive Poisson weight, excluding roundoff.

FspVersion.description: Schema tag of an FSP result.

description: Finite state projection result: the enumerated states and one snapshot per save time.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes.

numerical_error_certified.description: Always false: the reported error terms are estimates, not a certified bound.

run_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact run bytes.

snapshots.description: One snapshot per save time, in order, starting at time 0.

sparse_edges.description: Nonzero off-diagonal generator entries, transitions to the sink included.

species.description: Species names in the order of each state's counts.

states.description: Projected states in discovery order; state 0 is the initial state.

uniformization_rate.description: Uniformization rate λ: the largest total exit rate of any projected state, per second.

work.description: Deterministic work units spent, at most 200000000.

title: FspResult
